name: hud_sensor_tracker_parse_checkpoint_number_from_node
description: HudSensorTracker::ParseCheckpointNumberFromNode returns the nonnegative decimal suffix after the checkpoint node-name prefix when the node/context flags permit checkpoint handling.
known_limits: The smoke covers positive parse, disabled flags, missing context flag, negative clamp, and empty suffix. tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player pending-contact/checkpoint pass with MFC CString code shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x425060 validates the node flag 0x200000 gate, context node auxFlags bit 2 gate, ten-character prefix skip via CString::Right(max(length-10, 0)), atol parse, and negative-to-zero clamp.
The native smoke verifies representative accepted and rejected checkpoint names.
